title: Team members: the owner decides, with three new ticks
text: The owner now decides, with three new ticks on the Team screen: "Company forms (tax questionnaire)", "Can ask for new services" and "Can answer client decisions". A team member can do these only when the owner ticks them. Their forms and uploads always stay inside their own company, and a service request is always filed under the person who is signed in. Signing, generating documents, changing owners and members, and managing the team stay with the owners.
